spec_match.rationale: Creates the exact contested condition — a media query change and transition events pending around the same update, via a real iframe resize plus same-task transition trigger — and reports the true arrival order the spec fixes to step 3.10 before 3.11.

interactive.rationale: Shrink toggles the iframe width across the inner breakpoint and pokes the transition; the inner document timestamps every event and posts the ordered list out; reset restores.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the reported arrival order from the inner document; delivered with per-event timestamps.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles runs where only one source fired (no breakpoint crossing) with guidance; a broken srcdoc script-escaping bug was caught by the harness (silent inner failure) and fixed.

conformance.rationale: The suite's mq-change-before-animation-events manual assertion names this page as its procedure; the surface assertions run live.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run after the fix: real order captured — mq-change (matches true) at 14063.9ms before transitionrun/start at 14080.8ms — with the correct verdict; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: idt-order-observed asserts with the joined event order and mq-first flag.

design_system.rationale: MQ entries accent-blue, animation entries accent-emerald on paper (AA); CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: The order renders as a semantic ordered list with textual kinds and timestamps; iframe titled; status aria-live.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The iframe is max-width:100%; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Force truly-simultaneous pending events on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 141 the deferred transitionrun lands a frame after mq-change, so the ordering is trivially mq-first. On Chrome 153, where both become pending in the same update, verify the deterministic 3.10-before-3.11 order holds under the same click.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Report sequences as real ordered lists.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The arrival order is an <ol> with per-event text; colours are reinforcement.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Cap embedded frames at container width.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: iframe is width:480px with max-width:100%; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): after fixing a real srcdoc escaping bug the harness surfaced (the inner script never ran), the lab captures genuine cross-document event order — mq-change before all transition events on Chromium 141 — with clean console at both viewports.
